title: No bear in sight: Major Wall St banks set 2027 S&P 500 targets
summary: Investing.com - A new survey of eight Wall Street strategists puts the average S&P 500 year-end 2027 target at 8,638, implying roughly a 20% advance from current levels and what would be a fifth consecutive annual gain — the longest winning streak since 2007. The bullish consensus arrives against a turbulent near-term backdrop with the S&P 500 trading at lowest levels since May this year.
